_comment: Explicit island-area bounding boxes [min_lon, max_lon, min_lat, max_lat]. When a key is listed here it is authoritative for OSM element ownership, replacing the nearest-island-centre rule. Needed where centre+radius circles overlap two areas: Madeira's Ponta de São Lourenço islets sit closer to the Desertas centre than to Madeira's. Boxes must not overlap each other. Azores islands are deliberately absent and keep nearest-centre ownership.
